config firewall address
edit "Prefix-example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "example.com"
next

edit "Prefix-www.example.net"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "www.example.net"
next

edit "Prefix-10.0.0.0/24"
set subnet 10.0.0.0 255.255.255.0
next

edit "Prefix-172.16.5.5"
set subnet 172.16.5.5 255.255.255.255
next

edit "Prefix-10.1.1.1-10.1.1.9"
set type iprange
set start-ip 10.1.1.1
set end-ip 10.1.1.9
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "Prefix-example.com-Group"
set member "Prefix-example.com"
next

edit "Prefix-www.example.net-Group"
set member "Prefix-www.example.net"
next

edit "Prefix-10.0.0.0/24-Group"
set member "Prefix-10.0.0.0/24"
next

edit "Prefix-172.16.5.5-Group"
set member "Prefix-172.16.5.5"
next

edit "Prefix-10.1.1.1-10.1.1.9-Group"
set member "Prefix-10.1.1.1-10.1.1.9"
next

edit "Prefix-Generated Objects"
set member "Prefix-example.com" "Prefix-www.example.net" "Prefix-10.0.0.0/24" "Prefix-172.16.5.5" "Prefix-10.1.1.1-10.1.1.9"
next

end
